{{Top|leg}}
An '''Intravenous Access Unit''' ('''IAU''') was a medical device that was applied to an individual's chest. When activated, the catheter burrowed directly through the skin to enter the large subclavian vein attached to the [[Heart/Legends|heart]].<ref name="AJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm}}</ref> [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] were programmed to use Intravenous Access Units to treat enzyme eruptions in the third [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of the [[Pui-ui]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aurin Leith]] used one to treat [[Gebnerret Vibrion]] during his rescue from [[Selnesh Imperial Detention Center]]. She used it to administer [[Clondex]] and other medicines to treat his [[Zithrom's syndrome]].<ref name="AJ10" />
